name: unclear system status
description: Users cannot tell what the system is doing, whether an action is in progress, or whether a task has completed successfully.
aliases: system status|no feedback|missing feedback|loading unclear|progress unclear|unknown state|not sure what happened|no confirmation|status message missing|submission unclear
examples: I tapped save but nothing changed so I did not know if it worked. The page kept spinning without explaining what was happening. I submitted the form but never got a confirmation.

name: insufficient action feedback
description: The interface does not provide clear, timely, or meaningful feedback after user actions, making outcomes hard to interpret.
aliases: action feedback|button feedback|tap feedback|click feedback|response unclear|silent action|no response|delayed feedback|feedback missing|confirmation missing
examples: After pressing the button I could not tell if my input was accepted. The interface did not react when I selected an option. The confirmation appeared too late and I repeated the action.

name: confusing terminology
description: Labels, messages, or concepts use jargon, internal language, ambiguous wording, or terms that do not match the user’s mental model.
aliases: jargon|unclear wording|confusing labels|ambiguous labels|technical language|internal terminology|unclear copy|user language mismatch|plain language issue|unfamiliar term
examples: The screen used a product term I did not recognize. The label sounded technical and I was not sure what it meant. Two options seemed to mean the same thing.

name: navigation friction
description: Users struggle to find where to go, move between screens, understand location, or return to a previous step.
aliases: navigation|hard to navigate|lost|where to go|back button|menu confusing|path unclear|breadcrumb missing|cannot find page|wayfinding issue
examples: I could not find the settings page. I got lost after opening the menu. I wanted to go back but there was no obvious way to return.

name: inefficient workflow
description: The task can be completed, but it requires unnecessary steps, repeated actions, excessive time, or avoidable effort.
aliases: inefficient|too many steps|slow workflow|extra steps|repetitive task|workflow friction|takes too long|unnecessary effort|tedious|resource use
examples: I had to go through five screens to complete a simple action. The same information had to be entered more than once. The process worked but felt unnecessarily long.

name: high cognitive load
description: The interface forces users to remember information, interpret too many options, or make decisions without enough support.
aliases: cognitive load|mental effort|too much to think about|memory burden|recall burden|overwhelming choices|decision burden|hard to understand|complexity|confusing flow
examples: I had to remember information from the previous page. There were too many choices at once. I needed to stop and think about what the screen wanted from me.

name: poor discoverability
description: Useful actions, features, options, or content are present but not visible, recognizable, or easy to find when needed.
aliases: discoverability|hidden feature|hard to find|not obvious|buried option|invisible action|feature hidden|cannot discover|low visibility|missed option
examples: I only found the feature by accident. The option was hidden in a menu I would not normally open. I did not realize the icon was clickable.

name: inconsistent interface patterns
description: Similar elements, actions, labels, layouts, or behaviours are presented inconsistently across the interface.
aliases: inconsistent|inconsistency|different labels|different behavior|same action different place|standards issue|pattern mismatch|unpredictable UI|convention mismatch|component inconsistency
examples: The same action had different names on two pages. Buttons moved around between similar screens. A control behaved differently from what I expected elsewhere in the app.

name: poor user control
description: Users lack clear ways to cancel, undo, exit, back out, change choices, or control the interaction flow.
aliases: user control|no undo|cannot cancel|no exit|stuck in flow|forced path|cannot go back|no escape|reversibility issue|control missing
examples: I started the wrong process and could not cancel it. There was no way to undo the change. I felt forced to continue even though I wanted to leave.

name: poor error prevention
description: The design allows avoidable mistakes because constraints, validation, safe defaults, warnings, or confirmations are missing or weak.
aliases: error prevention|avoidable error|weak validation|unsafe default|preventable mistake|missing warning|missing confirmation|no constraints|mistake prone|error trap
examples: I accidentally deleted something without a confirmation. The form accepted a value that was clearly wrong. The default option caused me to make a mistake.

name: unclear error message
description: Error messages do not explain what went wrong, where the problem is, or how the user can fix it.
aliases: error message|unclear error|generic error|validation message|cannot diagnose|no recovery guidance|unhelpful error|error unclear|what went wrong|fix unclear
examples: The app said something went wrong but did not explain what. The form showed an error without marking the field. I could not tell how to correct the problem.

name: poor recovery from errors
description: After an error or unwanted state, users cannot easily recover, retry, correct the issue, or resume without losing progress.
aliases: error recovery|poor recovery|dead end|lost progress|retry missing|cannot recover|restart required|stuck after error|recovery path missing|restore issue
examples: After the error I had to start the whole task again. The app did not let me fix the failed field. I lost my progress when the submission failed.

name: accessibility barrier
description: The interface creates a barrier for users with disabilities or assistive needs, including issues with perception, operation, understanding, or compatibility.
aliases: accessibility|inaccessible|assistive technology|screen reader issue|keyboard issue|low vision|motor impairment|a11y|barrier|disability access
examples: I could not complete the task using assistive technology. The page was difficult to use with zoom enabled. A core action was inaccessible without a mouse.

name: keyboard access issue
description: Users cannot operate, navigate, focus, or complete interactive elements reliably using a keyboard or keyboard-like input.
aliases: keyboard access|keyboard navigation|tab order|keyboard trap|cannot tab|focus order|keyboard only|no keyboard support|tab navigation|keyboard operable
examples: I could not reach the button using Tab. Focus got trapped in the modal. The keyboard order did not match the visible order of the page.

name: poor focus visibility
description: Keyboard focus is missing, hard to see, inconsistent, obscured, or not clearly associated with the active element.
aliases: focus visible|focus indicator|focus unclear|keyboard focus|focus hidden|focus appearance|active element unclear|tab focus|focus ring missing|focus not visible
examples: I could not see which field was active. The focus outline disappeared on buttons. When I tabbed through the page, I lost track of my position.

name: low contrast
description: Text, icons, states, controls, or meaningful visual elements have insufficient contrast, making them difficult to perceive.
aliases: low contrast|contrast issue|hard to read|faint text|pale text|weak contrast|color contrast|invisible text|washed out|poor visibility
examples: The grey text was hard to read on the background. Disabled and active states looked almost the same. I struggled to see the icon in bright light.

name: text scaling issue
description: Text or layout does not remain readable, usable, or intact when users resize text, zoom, or use larger display settings.
aliases: resize text|text scaling|zoom issue|font size|large text|text clipped|content overlaps|responsive text|readability at zoom|magnification issue
examples: When I increased text size, buttons overlapped. At zoom, part of the form disappeared. The text became clipped and I could not read the full label.

name: missing non-text alternative
description: Images, icons, charts, media, or visual-only information lack equivalent text or accessible alternatives.
aliases: alt text|non-text content|image alternative|missing label|icon label|chart description|media alternative|text alternative|screen reader label|accessible name
examples: The icon had no label so I did not know what it did. The chart information was only visual. The image conveyed important information without text.

name: form input ambiguity
description: Form fields, instructions, required inputs, formats, validation rules, or input purposes are unclear to users.
aliases: form issue|input unclear|field label unclear|required field|format unclear|input purpose|validation unclear|form instructions|placeholder issue|field ambiguity
examples: I did not know which fields were required. The date format was unclear. The field label did not explain what information I was supposed to enter.

name: time pressure barrier
description: Users are rushed, timed out, interrupted, or unable to complete a task because time limits are not adjustable or clearly communicated.
aliases: time limit|timeout|session expired|rushed|time pressure|not enough time|auto logout|timer issue|extend time|lost due to timeout
examples: My session expired before I finished writing. I did not know there was a time limit. The page timed out and I lost my work.

name: motion or animation discomfort
description: Motion, animation, flashing, parallax, auto-updating content, or visual effects distract, disorient, or discomfort users.
aliases: motion|animation|flashing|parallax|moving content|auto update|animation discomfort|visual motion|distracting animation|reduce motion
examples: The animation made it hard to focus. Content moved while I was trying to read. The flashing effect was distracting and uncomfortable.

name: touch target issue
description: Interactive elements are too small, too close together, hard to tap, or difficult to activate accurately on touch devices.
aliases: touch target|small button|hard to tap|tap target|button too small|targets too close|mobile tapping|mis-tap|pointer target|touch accuracy
examples: I kept tapping the wrong option because the buttons were too close. The icon was too small to select comfortably. I needed several attempts to tap the control.

name: poor mobile responsiveness
description: The layout, content, or interaction does not adapt well to mobile screens, orientations, or small-device contexts.
aliases: mobile responsiveness|responsive issue|mobile layout|small screen|orientation issue|content off screen|horizontal scroll|bad mobile UI|viewport issue|mobile usability
examples: On my phone the button was partly off screen. The layout broke when I rotated the device. I had to scroll sideways to read the content.

name: visual clutter
description: The screen contains too much competing information, decoration, density, or weak visual hierarchy, making important elements harder to identify.
aliases: visual clutter|cluttered|busy layout|too much information|weak hierarchy|overloaded screen|messy UI|minimalist design issue|noise|crowded layout
examples: The page felt crowded and I did not know where to look first. Important actions were hidden among too many elements. The layout made the task feel overwhelming.

name: poor information structure
description: Information is grouped, ordered, sequenced, or related in a way that makes it difficult to understand or use.
aliases: information architecture|structure issue|poor grouping|bad ordering|sequence issue|relationships unclear|content organization|logical order|meaningful sequence|hierarchy issue
examples: The information appeared in an order that did not make sense. Related controls were separated across the page. I could not understand how sections connected.

name: search and filtering friction
description: Search, filtering, sorting, or results presentation does not help users find relevant content efficiently.
aliases: search issue|bad search|filter issue|sort issue|irrelevant results|cannot find results|weak filtering|search quality|results unclear|findability
examples: The search results did not match what I typed. Filters were hard to understand. I could not sort results in the way I needed.

name: privacy or trust concern
description: Users feel uncertain, uncomfortable, or distrustful about data visibility, privacy, permissions, security, or how their information will be used.
aliases: privacy|trust|data privacy|security concern|unclear visibility|data use|privacy friction|sensitive data|consent unclear|confidence issue
examples: I was not sure who could see my entry. The app asked for information without explaining why. I hesitated because the data use was unclear.

name: permission or access friction
description: Users are blocked, confused, or delayed by roles, permissions, access rules, authentication, or authorization flows.
aliases: permission|access issue|blocked access|role confusion|authentication issue|authorization|login problem|access denied|account permission|cannot access
examples: I could not open a feature because of my role. The app said access denied but did not explain why. I was not sure which account I needed to use.

name: data loss risk
description: The interface risks losing user input, progress, changes, drafts, or state because saving, persistence, or recovery is weak.
aliases: data loss|lost progress|draft lost|changes not saved|autosave missing|state lost|work disappeared|save issue|persistence issue|input lost
examples: My written response disappeared after I navigated away. The app did not save my draft. I lost everything after refreshing the page.

name: unclear confirmation
description: Confirmation, review, or finalization steps do not make users confident about what will happen or what has already happened.
aliases: confirmation|review step|submit unclear|final action unclear|success message unclear|are you sure|outcome unclear|completion unclear|confirmation dialog|finalization
examples: Before submitting I was not sure what would be sent. The success screen did not explain what happened next. The confirmation dialog used vague wording.

name: insufficient help or guidance
description: Users lack adequate instructions, examples, contextual help, documentation, or onboarding when they need support.
aliases: help|documentation|guidance|onboarding|instructions missing|contextual help|example missing|support missing|how to use|explanation needed
examples: I needed an example but none was provided. The help page did not answer my question. The first screen did not explain how the process worked.

name: poor support for returning users
description: The interface does not make repeated or frequent tasks faster through saved preferences, defaults, shortcuts, or personalization.
aliases: returning user|frequent task|shortcut missing|personalization|saved preferences|repeated use|accelerator missing|expert user|defaults missing|efficiency shortcut
examples: I complete this task every day but the app makes me start from scratch. My previous choices were not remembered. There was no shortcut for the action I use most.

name: content readability issue
description: Text content is hard to read, scan, understand, or act on because of length, density, phrasing, formatting, or presentation.
aliases: readability|hard to read|dense text|long paragraph|scannability|content clarity|copy issue|poor formatting|text heavy|reading burden
examples: The instructions were too long and hard to scan. I had to reread the paragraph several times. Important details were buried in dense text.

name: unexpected system behavior
description: The system behaves in a way users do not expect, including bugs, glitches, incorrect outputs, crashes, or broken interactions.
aliases: bug|glitch|unexpected behavior|crash|broken|does not work|incorrect result|failure|wrong output|system error
examples: The app crashed when I opened the summary. The screen showed the wrong value. A button stopped working after I changed a setting.

name: assistive technology compatibility issue
description: The interface does not expose correct names, roles, values, relationships, or status updates to assistive technologies.
aliases: screen reader|name role value|aria|status message|semantic issue|assistive technology compatibility|accessible name|role value|programmatic relationship|robustness
examples: The screen reader announced the button without a useful name. Status changes were not read aloud. The field relationship was not exposed to assistive technology.

name: poor input modality support
description: The interaction depends too heavily on one input method and does not work well with keyboard, touch, pointer, voice, or alternative inputs.
aliases: input modality|pointer gestures|keyboard alternative|touch alternative|voice input|single input method|gesture issue|drag only|alternative input|device input
examples: The feature required dragging and had no alternative. I could not complete the task without a mouse. The gesture was difficult to perform on my device.

name: language or localization issue
description: The interface language, formatting, examples, cultural assumptions, or localization choices do not fit the user context.
aliases: localization|translation issue|language issue|locale|date format|currency format|regional format|cultural mismatch|wrong language|internationalization
examples: The date format confused me. Some labels appeared in another language. The example did not fit my local context.

name: poor goal alignment
description: The interface emphasizes system steps, metadata, or secondary actions instead of helping users accomplish their actual goal.
aliases: goal alignment|user goal|purpose fit|goal support|task purpose|outcome mismatch|not what I need|wrong priority|goal friction|system centric
examples: I wanted to write the entry, but the app made me deal with settings first. The screen focused on system details instead of my task. The flow did not match what I was trying to accomplish.

name: context of use mismatch
description: The design does not fit the real conditions in which users use it, such as device, location, environment, time pressure, interruptions, or user constraints.
aliases: context of use|environment mismatch|real conditions|situated use|commuting|mobile context|interruption|constraints|use context|not practical
examples: The feature worked poorly while commuting. I could not use the interface comfortably outdoors. The task expected more attention than I had in the moment.

name: ambiguous visual cues
description: The interface relies on unclear visual cues, color alone, sensory characteristics, or weak affordances to communicate meaning or available actions.
aliases: visual cue|color only|affordance unclear|sensory characteristic|icon ambiguity|state unclear|looks clickable|visual state|meaning unclear|cue ambiguity
examples: I could not tell which items were selected because only the color changed. The icon looked decorative rather than clickable. The page referred to the green button but I could not distinguish it.
